name: Ciudad del Este
registryAssessment: Paraguay's official Dirección General del Servicio Nacional de Catastro exposes a public cadastral viewer and a public GeoServer WFS parcel layer; the official municipality directory also records a cooperation agreement with the Municipalidad de Ciudad del Este. This is evidence of a local/national cadastral source, not a claim of complete current citywide coverage.

queries.query: Ciudad del Este Paraguay official cadastral map parcel GIS cadastre municipal
queries.result: Found the official Servicio Nacional de Catastro municipality page, public viewer, and Ciudad del Este municipal cooperation record; the official public viewer's JavaScript identifies the parcel WFS service.

queries.query: Paraguay catastro mapa parcelario Ciudad del Este sitio oficial
queries.result: Found the official Servicio Nacional de Catastro municipality directory and its Ciudad del Este cooperation document, plus the official public cadastral viewer and WFS capabilities.

officialSources.observation: HTTP 200; current JavaScript/configuration names the public GeoServer WFS endpoint /geoserver/ows, parcel layer snc:parcelas_activas, and viewer CRS EPSG:32721.

officialSources.role: Officially hosted Ciudad del Este municipal cadastral map PDF
officialSources.observation: Public map credits Municipalidad de Ciudad del Este, Dirección de Catastro; states UTM, WGS 84, zone 21S, source MapInfo 2020.

geometryDecision.reason: A bounded anonymous WFS request for safe id plus geometry returned three full MultiPolygon features in EPSG:4326 GeoJSON. The exact WUP point request was not used as evidence of absence; the point was preserved without shifting.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official SNC public parcel layer snc:parcelas_activas.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Capabilities, schema, bounded anonymous ID+geometry responses, and the viewer's current configuration were verified. Complete current citywide coverage and exact-point containment were not independently established.

sourceSchema.nativeIdentity: The native parcel layer's id field; WFS feature ids are emitted as parcelas_activas.<id>.
unsafeFieldsNotRequested: owner, address, titleholder, contact or personal fields
sourceSchema.crs: Viewer configuration uses EPSG:32721 (WGS 84 / UTM zone 21S); retained sample coordinates were requested as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON.
